cloud.title: ToHuus Cloud
cloud.description: In the ToHuus app open Settings › Home Assistant and tap "Connect Home Assistant". Enter the code shown there (valid 10 minutes). Home Assistant then connects to {url} by itself, nothing at home has to be reachable from the internet.

data_description.code: Eight characters, e.g. ABCD-EFGH. Upper or lower case does not matter.

own_server.title: Own ToHuus Hub
own_server.description: Enter the address Home Assistant reaches your ToHuus Hub at, plus the code from Settings › Home Assistant › "Connect Home Assistant". Instead of a code you can paste a token from Settings › Access & AI › New access › "Home Assistant".

data_description.code: Eight characters, valid 10 minutes, works once.
data_description.token: Starts with sw_. Only needed without a code.
data_description.verify_ssl: Turn off only for self-signed certificates.

reauth_confirm.title: Connect again
reauth_confirm.description: ToHuus Hub at {url} no longer accepts the access. Create a new code in ToHuus (Settings › Home Assistant › "Connect Home Assistant") or paste a new token.

reconfigure.title: Change ToHuus Hub address
reconfigure.description: Leave code and token empty to keep the current access. Moving to ToHuus Cloud: enter {cloud_url} and a code from the cloud household.

error.cannot_connect: Can't reach ToHuus Hub at this address.
error.invalid_auth: The token was rejected. Create a new "Home Assistant" access in ToHuus Hub.
error.not_supported: This ToHuus Hub is too old for the integration. Update ToHuus Hub first.
error.invalid_code: This code is not valid (any more). Create a new one in the app and enter it within 10 minutes.
error.too_many_attempts: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and create a new code.
error.code_or_token: Enter the code from the app (or a token).
error.pairing_not_supported: This ToHuus Hub does not know codes yet. Update it, or paste a token instead.

abort.already_configured: This ToHuus Hub is already set up.
abort.wrong_instance: That is a different ToHuus Hub than the one set up here.

init.title: ToHuus Hub in Home Assistant
init.description: Sensors are always there. Choose what else to show.

data.cookidoo_sync: Send the Cookidoo week to ToHuus Hub

data_description.live_updates: Keeps a connection open so changes show up within a second or two. Without it, Home Assistant asks every minute.
data_description.display_mode: For kitchen displays shown as image entities.
data_description.cookidoo_sync: Reads the planned dishes from the Cookidoo integration every 3 hours and whenever the calendar changes, and puts them into the ToHuus Hub meal plan.
data_description.cookidoo_entity: Usually calendar.cookidoo_speiseplan. Leave empty to use it automatically as soon as it exists.
data_description.bridge: Lets ToHuus Hub see your to-do lists, calendars, people, notify services and voice-exposed devices (names and areas only, for the house info cards for babysitters and guests), keep the lists and calendars you choose in ToHuus Hub (Settings › Home Assistant) in sync both ways, send notifications through the companion app and use NFC tag scans as quick actions. Who leads per topic: the "who leads" selects of this device.
data_description.notify_services: Notify services, e.g. notify.mobile_app_… or a TV/speaker. Home Assistant receives the notifications over the live connection and passes them on. Leave empty if ToHuus already sends them per person (Settings › Home Assistant › Notifications).
data_description.notify_events: Only these kinds go to the services above.
